cases.purpose: Bare dash submits binary standard input through the fixture backend
cases.oracle: Literal operation contract; fixture-owned adapter and independent setup controls supply known bytes, statuses and process identities.
cases.comparison: Exact candidate status and observations, with bounded raw inputs, outputs, events and process observations retained separately. Missing later branches remain failures/gaps.
cases.candidate_script:
[[ $UID == 2000 && $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home && -O /tmp/parity-case && -O /tmp/parity-home && -r /etc/bashos-parity-vm && -r /sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor ]] || { echo 'not a disposable parity guest' >&2; exit 98; }
marker=$(< /etc/bashos-parity-vm); vendor=$(< /sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor)
[[ $marker =~ ^[0-9A-Fa-f]{8}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{12}$ && $vendor == QEMU ]] || { echo 'guest identity mismatch' >&2; exit 98; }
export BASHLPR_SPOOL="$HOME/spool" BASHLPR_BACKEND="$HOME/backend" BASHLPR_TIMEOUT=0
export LPR_FIXTURE_MODE=barestdin
lpr - < 'data/file with space' > "$HOME/barestdin.out" 2> "$HOME/barestdin.err"; printf 'status=%s\n' "$?"
"$HOME/backend" --check barestdin

cases.purpose: Bare stdin rejects a missing backend before creating spool entries
cases.oracle: Literal operation contract; fixture-owned adapter and independent setup controls supply known bytes, statuses and process identities.
cases.comparison: Exact candidate status and observations, with bounded raw inputs, outputs, events and process observations retained separately. Missing later branches remain failures/gaps.
cases.candidate_script:
[[ $UID == 2000 && $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home && -O /tmp/parity-case && -O /tmp/parity-home && -r /etc/bashos-parity-vm && -r /sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor ]] || { echo 'not a disposable parity guest' >&2; exit 98; }
marker=$(< /etc/bashos-parity-vm); vendor=$(< /sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor)
[[ $marker =~ ^[0-9A-Fa-f]{8}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{12}$ && $vendor == QEMU ]] || { echo 'guest identity mismatch' >&2; exit 98; }
export BASHLPR_SPOOL="$HOME/spool"
unset BASHLPR_BACKEND
lpr < 'data/file with space' > "$HOME/missing.out" 2> "$HOME/missing.err"; rc=$?
printf 'status=%s\n' "$rc"
[[ ! -s $HOME/missing.out && $(< "$HOME/missing.err") == *'no backend configured'* ]] && echo rejection=ok || echo rejection=BAD
shopt -s nullglob dotglob
entries=("$HOME/spool"/*)
[[ ${#entries[@]} == 0 ]] && echo spool=empty || echo spool=BAD
